name: AP_PREPAY_HISTORY_ALL
description: AP_PREPAY_HISTORY_ALL countains the history of a prepayment which includes its related prepayment applications, prepayment unapplications and prepayment application adjustments.  A row is created in APPH when the Prepayment Applied, Prepayment Unapplied or Prepayment Adjusted accounting events are captured.

columns.name: PREPAY_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Prepayment History Unique Identifier

columns.name: PREPAY_INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the Prepayment

columns.name: PREPAY_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Prepayment line number in the prepayment history.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the accounting event of the prepayment application, unapplication or adjustment

columns.name: HISTORICAL_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates if upgrade created record

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the recipient Invoice

columns.name: INVOICE_ADJUSTMENT_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Related adjusted invoice event that resulted in a cascade event

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: POSTED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates whether the prepayment application, prepayment unapplication, or prepayment adjustment was successfully accounted or not

columns.name: RELATED_PREPAY_APP_EVENT_ID
columns.description: For cascade events, related prepayment application event

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting transaction event type. Values can be Prepayment Application, Prepayment Unapplication, or Prepayment Adjustment

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates the application identifier of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates the identifier of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: INVOICE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number of the recipient invoice.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the prepayment.

columns.name: BC_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Accounting Event raised for Encumbrance accounting

columns.name: GAIN_LOSS_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment related transaction resulted in gain or loss (G or L)

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
